message.content:
This editorial illustration features a 4x5 grid of rectangular panels arranged like a video conference screen. A large, gray serif title "TEMPO" spans the upper third. Various cartoon human characters occupy individual panels, depicted with distinct features: some wear black headsets or white earbuds, while others hold objects like a white mug. One panel in the top right contains a white cat with a human-like facial expression. On the left, bold yellow text reads "AWAS TEROR DIGITAL," above smaller yellow text: "SEJUMLAH PERTEMUAN ONLINE BERTEMA KRITIS KEPADA PEMERINTAH DISERANG. AKUN MEDIA SOSIAL PARA AKTIVIS JUGA KERAP DIBOBOL. SIAPA PELAKUNYA?".

The panels show diverse expressions: a woman in a blue hijab covers her mouth, a bald man with a beard appears angry, and another person covers their face with their hands. In the middle-right, a hand holds a silver metallic lighter. Large yellow and orange flames erupt from the lighter, spreading across several panels and partially obscuring the people behind them. A hand in one panel holds a black handheld radio near a sign that reads "BAKSO" backwards. The bottom includes a barcode, a QR code, and text "29 JUNI-5 JULI 2020". A red border frames the left and bottom edges.
